description:
The Power to Move Mountains

Designed by Dan Fischer and built around premium components, the Raptor is powered by the brutal Ananda M100 mid-drive motor. All new for 2026 Cyberbike Raptor Pro is a full-suspension electric mountain bike built for everything you throw at it- steep climbs, rough trails, city cruising or long-distance riding. A Shimano SLX 12-speed drivetrain gives riders a wide gear range for technical terrain, while the RockShox suspension package, Tektro 4-piston hydraulic disc brakes, and 203mm rotors deliver the control and confidence needed for aggressive off-road riding.

720Wh Removable Battery & Long-Range Riding

The 2026 Raptor Pro is powered by a high-capacity 720Wh removable battery, giving riders the range needed for longer trail loops, mixed-terrain rides, and full-day exploration. Depending on rider weight, assist level, terrain, elevation gain, temperature, and riding style, the Raptor Pro can deliver approximately 40-70 miles of range per charge. The battery is integrated cleanly into the downtube for a streamlined look while remaining fully removable for convenient charging, storage, and transport. Whether you are riding local trails, commuting during the week, or exploring farther from home, the 720Wh battery gives the Raptor Pro the endurance to keep going.

RockShox Full-Suspension Performance

The 2026 Raptor Pro features a RockShox suspension system designed to improve comfort, traction, and control on rough terrain. Up front, the RockShox Recon Silver TK fork helps keep the front wheel composed over rocks, roots, ruts, and trail chatter. In the rear, the RockShox Deluxe Select+ shock absorbs repeated impacts and helps the bike stay planted through uneven sections of trail. Together, the front and rear suspension give the Raptor Pro a more capable and confidence-inspiring ride than a hardtail eBike, especially on technical descents, loose terrain, and longer rides where comfort and control make a major difference. Shimano SLX 12-Speed Drivetrain

The 2026 Raptor Pro is equipped with a Shimano SLX 12-speed drivetrain, giving riders a wide gear range for steep climbs, fast flats, and changing trail conditions. SLX is known for reliable shifting, durable construction, and trail-focused performance, making it a strong match for a full-suspension mid-drive electric mountain bike. Because mid-drive eBikes send motor power through the drivetrain, smooth and dependable shifting is especially important. The SLX 12-speed setup helps riders maintain cadence, manage climbs more efficiently, and stay in the right gear across demanding terrain.

Tektro 4-Piston Hydraulic Disc Brakes

The Raptor Pro uses a Tektro 4-piston hydraulic disc brake system paired with large 203mm rotors for strong, consistent stopping power. The 4-piston design provides more braking force and control than basic 2-piston systems, while the 203mm rotors help manage heat and improve braking confidence on longer descents. Whether you are controlling speed on steep downhill sections, riding loose gravel, or navigating technical terrain, the Raptor Pro’s hydraulic braking system gives you the modulation and stopping power needed to ride with confidence.

Why Choose the 2026 Cyberbike Raptor Pro?

The 2026 Cyberbike Raptor Pro is designed for riders who want a powerful full-suspension mid-drive eBike with trail-ready components and long-range battery capacity. The Ananda M100 motor delivers efficient climbing power, the 720Wh battery supports extended rides, and the RockShox suspension, Shimano SLX 12-speed drivetrain, and Tektro 4-piston hydraulic brakes give the bike the control needed for real off-road performance. For riders looking for a capable electric mountain bike that can handle steep climbs, rough trails, and long exploration days, the Raptor Pro is built to deliver power, range, and confidence in one complete package.

Who This Is For

Trail and outdoor enthusiasts

Aggressive single track riders

Riders returning to cycling after time away

Riders who want help with climbs and long distances

Recreational riders seeking comfort and power

City rider who want a beautiful machine

Motorsport enthusiasts drawn to electric

Anyone who wants to ride more and farther
